title: Act: Add planPreload to the engine
summary: Create game/src/engine/planPreload.ts with planPreload and the PreloadPlan type.
description: Create the new engine module with the pure planPreload function that collects object assets and dust effect assets from a SceneDef.
acceptance_criteria: planPreload dedupes asset ids in first-seen order
planPreload reports unknown ids separately from load

steps.action: Create the file. Export type PreloadPlan = { load: string[]; unknown: string[] }. Export function planPreload(scene: SceneDef, manifest: AssetManifest): PreloadPlan. Build refs from scene.objects[].asset (skip undefined), then from scene.effects entries whose type is 'dust' (their asset). Dedupe with a Set while keeping insertion order. Put an id in load if some manifest.assets entry has that id, otherwise in unknown.
steps.expected: npx tsc --noEmit in game/ passes and planPreload is importable
